evals.prompt: Create Plane work items for this implementation plan, but I did not give you a project id.
evals.expected_output: The agent should resolve project scope from repo-local .plane-project.json, a verified Plane URL, or list_projects with a user choice before any project-scoped MCP call. It should fill project name and identifier from Plane results, and should not infer from project name, identifier, or unverified URL text.

evals.prompt: Move all unfinished work from Sprint 23 to Sprint 24.
evals.expected_output: The agent should treat this as cycle planning, resolve project id, list/retrieve source and destination cycles, confirm the bulk transfer, then use cycle transfer/add tools rather than modules.

evals.prompt: Group the auth revamp tasks together and write a short project note about the implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: The agent should use modules for feature grouping and pages for durable project documentation, checking feature availability and existing modules/pages before writing.

evals.prompt: Triage new customer requests and accept the authentication bug reports into the backlog.
evals.expected_output: The agent should use intake tools first, inspect pending intake items, preserve source context when accepting items, and avoid creating normal work items directly before triage.

evals.prompt: Post a project status update: we are blocked by API auth and the timeline is at risk.
evals.expected_output: The agent should use project-level status/update behavior rather than only a work-item comment, choose an At Risk-style update, and report scope plus writes performed.
